resources.string: ATHENA uses this service strictly to automate actions inside apps you have explicitly checked in the Whitelist. ATHENA never logs passwords, reads credit card information, or interacts with unapproved apps.

ATHENA requires Accessibility access to interact with your whitelisted applications (e.g. typing a message or opening a video upon your PC command).

• No personal keystrokes are recorded.
• Password and payment fields are strictly blocked.
• You can revoke app access at any time in the Whitelist settings.
